text:
Carmen: Quick sync from today's hallway tests — users click the starter strip banner but expect a tiny step list inline, not just a CTA.
Noah: saw that too. The compact strip is good for non-blocking discovery but lacks clarity that it's a mini-checklist.
Ellen: metrics check: conversion from click->complete fell ~5% after we swapped to the strip only. Copy might be the issue.
Tariq: accessibility: strip CTA contrast is ~3.7:1 on light theme, and screen reader reads it as "link" only. Need role and aria-labels.
Carmen: copy candidates to A/B: "Create demo workspace", "Open setup checklist", "Use a starter sample". I prefer the first for clarity.
Noah: also propose microcopy under CTA (one line): "Starter templates + prompts — 2 min". Helps set expectation.
Ellen: proposal: hybrid pattern — keep starter strip but add an inline 3-item preview (Invite a teammate; Deploy sample app; Run example prompt). Add a small "Open full checklist" link that spawns the modal flow.
Tariq: a11y fixes: add role="region" and aria-label to the strip, ensure the CTA is included in the tab order (single Tab), and change label for SR from "link" to "Start setup: Create demo workspace". Also bump contrast to >=4.5:1. Quick CSS patch:
```
.starter-strip .cta { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); color: #041f45; }
```
OnboardBot: Prototype link updated by @Ellen — https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/starter-strip-v2 (variants A/B + compact preview).
Carmen: telemetry plan: events: starter_strip_click, starter_preview_open, starter_modal_open, starter_strip_dismiss. Experiment rule: if dismissed, hide for 14 days.
Noah: add persistence for power users: option to always open modal saved in profile for Dedicated customers. Avoids nagging.
Ellen: eng estimate?
Tariq: dev estimate ~3 days (copy + contrast + tabindex + telemetry). Modal already exists so minimal wiring.
Carmen: decision: ship hybrid — strip default + inline preview + full checklist modal. Implement copy A/B with "Create demo workspace" vs "Open setup checklist". Run 2-week experiment.
Noah: I'll file the ticket with Figma links, a11y checklist, and event names. Thanks all :thumbsup:
